question: How much does a website from Rafizaweb cost?
answer: From Rp699,000 for the Small Business Starter package (a 1-page landing page), Rp1,499,000 for Business Growth (2–4 pages and 3 blog articles for SEO), and Rp4,999,000 for Business Prime (10+ pages, custom features, and 10 blog articles). Every package includes hosting and a .com domain for the first year, responsive design on every device, and WhatsApp, social media, and Google Maps integration. Renewal in later years is charged separately.
